summary: At the protected source, HighBarService StreamState builds its initial full snapshot on the subscriber worker while holding the state shared lock, matching the architecture document. Separately, GrpcGatewayModule BroadcastSnapshot runs on the engine thread, builds an incremental snapshot and publishes it through ring/DeltaBus/coordinator. The frame-tick planner orders sparse-event projection and complete replacement, and grants a new live basis only after enqueue succeeds. Preserve these distinct source paths when changing callbacks or snapshot ordering; a subscription path is not authority to dispatch commands on a gRPC worker, and a shared lock alone is not a new proof about arbitrary engine-manager access. This audit did not execute native concurrency or manager walks.
title: Subscription snapshots and coordinator publication have distinct thread paths
